faces.name: Junkyard Scrapper
faces.oracleText: Whenever a nontoken artifact you control enters, exile a random nonland artifact card with lesser mana value from your library. You may cast that card until the end of your next turn.

faces.name: Junkyo Bell
faces.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may have target creature you control get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of creatures you control. If you do, sacrifice that creature at the beginning of the next end step.
